honesty: Not validated yet. This is a post-session score of that assumption pack against free OpenF1 or FastF1 results, not a live forecast and not a rival model. Predicted finish order is qualifying order, because the pack gives every car the same strategy time. An undercut is predicted only when the pack stops the car behind on an earlier lap than the car ahead.
assumption: Pit-lane loss is 22 seconds, the base lap is 95 seconds, and compound life matches the bundled Bahrain assumption pack. The tank is 110 kg and the car uses 1 kg of fuel per lap, so a long race is not rejected for fuel. The same pack is used for every round. These are not measured 2026 circuit facts.
